gloss: look on one's face; expression; grimace

definitions.gloss: look on one's face; facial expression; grimace
definitions.explanation: The expression or look on someone's face, almost always used when the expression is intense, frightening, or distorted with emotion such as anger, fear, or desperation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{恐|おそ}ろしい→恐ろしい：02338_osoroshii⟧{形相|ぎょうそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{睨|にら}まれた→睨む：02136_niramu⟧。
examples.english: I was glared at with a terrifying expression.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鬼|おに}→鬼：02184_oni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような{形相|ぎょうそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{怒鳴|どな}った→怒鳴る：05340_donaru⟧。
examples.english: He shouted with a demonic look on his face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{形相|ぎょうそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}って→走る：00519_hashiru⟧くる⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: Seeing someone running toward me with a desperate look, I wondered if something had happened.

notes:
USAGE:
{形相|ぎょうそう} is almost exclusively used for intense, dramatic, or frightening facial expressions. It is not used for neutral or pleasant expressions — use ⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧ for general facial expressions. Common modifiers include ⟦{恐|おそ}ろしい→恐ろしい：02338_osoroshii⟧ (terrifying), ⟦{鬼|おに}→鬼：02184_oni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような (demonic), ⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (desperate), and {血走|ちばし}った (bloodshot).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{恐|おそ}ろしい→恐ろしい：02338_osoroshii⟧{形相|ぎょうそう} (terrifying expression)
- ⟦{鬼|おに}→鬼：02184_oni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような{形相|ぎょうそう} (demonic look)
- ⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{形相|ぎょうそう} (desperate look)
- ⟦すごい→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧{形相|ぎょうそう} (fierce/intense expression)
